summary: Well-structured plan that faithfully implements the analysis's recommended approach (Option A for CI, Option C for DinD). Task breakdown is granular with clear boundaries — 11 tasks across 3 phases, each with specific and testable acceptance criteria covering both happy path and edge cases. Dependency ordering is logical (CI foundations before DinD features before docs). Risk assessment identifies 6 concrete risks with actionable mitigations. Test strategy covers unit, integration, and regression scenarios. All three open questions from the analysis are addressed by explicit design decisions. Minor observations: (1) no explicit rollback plan stated, though rollback is trivial for additive workflow changes; (2) docs/index.md may need updating to reference the new docs/guides/testing.md; (3) Phase 1 tasks are independent and could be explicitly marked as parallelizable for the coder agent. None of these rise to the level of requiring revision.
